name: Cremation
overview: Scripture acknowledges the physical return of the body to the earth, as seen in Genesis 3:19 and Ecclesiastes 12:7, where the dust returns to the ground and the spirit returns to God. The practice of burning bones is also mentioned, both as a means of judgment in Amos 2:1 and in the context of handling the dead in Amos 6:10 and Joshua 7:25. These passages demonstrate that while the body’s physical state changes after death, the soul’s destiny remains with God, emphasizing the spiritual over the physical in the Christian understanding of death and resurrection.
